Overview.Name: Anugu Susmitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (small portion)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + egg curry (2 eggs)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Chicken curry (small portion) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Start every meal with egg, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Keep rice portions controlled to support visible fat loss.
For sweet cravings, eat full protein portion first and wait 10 minutes before taking anything extra.
For spicy cravings, choose pan cooked food instead of fried outside food.
On emotionally low days, do not skip meals. Structured eating improves mood stability.
With consistency, expect gradual waist reduction and improved body tone in 8–10 weeks.
